newsitem.title: UK: Metals mostly up but below AM highs.
newsitem.headline: Metals mostly up but below AM highs.

text.p: COPPER - Holds firmer around morning highs, correcting to sell-off earlier this week. Specs looking to sell above $2,280.
LEAD - Stalls above $660, but still steadier.
ZINC - Off highs, but market eyeing $1,500 overhead.
ALUMINIUM - Just below highs, gains today reflect technical bounce. TIN - Quiet, slightly higher. NICKEL - Sold into above $6,900.
